entries.title: $37.5 million stolen from C.R.E.A.M. lending platform

links.linkText: "DeFi Protocols Cream Finance, Alpha Exploited in Flash Loan Attack; $37.5M Lost"

entries.body: A hacker was able to code a <button class="define-target" id="smart-contract">smart contract</button> that tricked C.R.E.A.M. into believing it was from a trusted source. They were then able to make off with $37.5 million worth of Ethereum and stablecoins in what was only the first of several major exploits of the platform in 2021.

"Binance faces criticism over handling of rug pull incident and frozen funds"

entries.body:
PopcornSwap launched on BNB Chain and then immediately drained its , making off with tokens priced at around $2 million.

Binance stated that they had been able to freeze users' assets on the BNB Chain partway through the incident. However, as of June 2023, Binance had not taken any steps to return the frozen funds to their original owners.

entries.title: Saddle Finance exploited within hours of launch
entries.body:
The Saddle Finance project, a of the Curve Finance project, launched on January 20. It promised it would "eliminate ".

The project was exploited only hours later, by attackers who stole more than 7.9 BTC (~$275,000) by taking advantage of high slippage on the platform.
